entry_points.text: Slow resolver brackets hugetlb protection, clears the huge mask and descends. Fast grab runs interrupt-disabled without sleeping, recording references or pins for fallback.

General fault normalizes, checks policy, delegates huge vs ordinary paths and accounts. Huge fault aligns, serializes by offset, and selects allocation, marker, migration, poison, userfault, copy or access handling.
Effective policy prefers operation, area, then task policy, advancing interleave offsets by area start and fault displacement scaled to huge granularity before node derivation.
Anon preparation returns when tracking exists, else takes read protection with retry, allocates tracking with failure as out-of-memory, and releases protection taken here.

exports.text: Pin handling for folios and ranges: add one pin, release page or folio arrays by coalescing same-folio groups, optionally marking folios dirty under lock.
General and hugetlb fault entries plus repair of per-area reservation state with restore intent after failed huge operations.
Huge allocation via per-area, pool and buddy layers with placement and reservations, plus controller charge, commit, uncharge and lookup.
Helpers for NUMA policy, huge unmap with sharing-aware notify, fault-mutex choice, anon preparation, large copy, contiguity, cache presence and walk brackets.

hazards.text: Callers must reject encoded counts, tolerate nulls, require contiguity, and expect fork, writeback, split and copy races; dumps must not instantiate and must skip special pages. Coordination uses FOLL_GET, PIN, WRITE, FORCE, TOUCH, DUMP, SPLIT, LONGTERM, P2PDMA with VM, error, huge-size, mask and bias markers.

Unshare plus write and unexpected completion or errors are programming faults. Huge paths must resample under lock and abandon on mismatch. Status uses EFAULT, EBUSY, EAGAIN and VM_FAULT_ERROR, RETRY, COMPLETED, SIGSEGV, OOM, HWPOISON_LARGE with index.

Need-to-commit races need rollback of quota and charges; undo returns quota only without global reservation use and skips termination for enforced copies. Draining excludes poisoned, isolated and pin-incompatible entries. External helpers live outside this dossier.

invariants.text: Groups are sized by run length or pointer scan. Pins keep a reference, use exact counts or bias, skip zero folios, record pinned state once, and fast unpin skips validation.
Nonwritable write is allowed only under force on private may-write areas for exclusive anon pages, gated by soft-dirty and userfault. Unshare applies only to read-only pins.
Descent validates tables, dispatches leaves, gates protection-none, write and unshare, acquires references, and handles pfn and dump holes. Huge followers report full coverage; one build is disabled.
Gate lookup rejects writes and needs populated tables. Forced faults map intent to fault flags with retry handling. Droppable areas suppress exhaustion; areas are unusable after delegation.
Huge faults handle poison, guard, migration and userfault tracking with reservation checks and restore repair. Allocation maps outcomes to quota with rollback and drains only compatible entries.
Admission is a no-op when disabled, else charges regular or reserved budget with hierarchical events. Commit records folio ownership with per-node usage; uncharge reverses counters and references.
Huge entries derive protection with writability, youth and arch adaptation. Unmap uses notifier coverage with sharing expansion, private invalidation, hashed mutex choice, and hint-last large copies.

locks.text: Dirty marking samples locklessly then holds the folio lock only for clean-to-dirty change. Gate lookup holds the mapped leaf only while sampling.
Huge followers run under caller-held table locks. Middle descent locks to revalidate and unlocks on all exits; leaf resolution holds the mapped lock through acquisition.
Walks take read-side hugetlb protection only for hugetlb areas, consistently using the shareable or private reservation lock.
Huge faults order fault mutex, shared access, then table lock, releasing outer locks for waits. Copy returns with table lock held. Subpool and global list changes need their locks.

state_machines.text: Resolution walks top to leaf via presence checks, leaf dispatch, protection-none, write and unshare gating, acquisition with touch handling, dump-aware holes and huge coverage masks.
Pins are acquired with exact or biased counts and validation, optionally dirtied under lock, then released in coalesced groups, with zero pages bypassing pins.
Forced faults map completion, error and retry to lock actions. Huge copy reuses exclusive folios, else allocates, copies, notifies and installs with revalidation and reclaim retry.
Allocation runs admission, reuse or surplus creation outside the global lock, then publication with reservation use, ownership and charging, unwinding on early failure and freeing on late failure.

structs.text: Folios track references and pins; areas link flags, address space and file; entries expose presence and protection state. Fault state aligns the address and fills table data after allocation.

Subpools track max, in-use and reserved counts with a no-limit sentinel; global state tracks free and per-node lists. Placement bundles node, mode and mask; controller holds budgets, events and usage.
